name: Nikya of the Old Ways
description: Leader of the Zhur-Taa clan who declared a blood feud on the Rakdos.

description_citations.text: "Rubblebelt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ruzi meets Nikya of the Zhur-Taa clan and tells her his sister and the infant were murdered by Rakdos.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Nikya, convinced by the bloodwriting her scouts saw, declares everyone loyal to the Rakdos demon guilty of a bloodcrime against the Gruul.
timeline.quote: They will be slaughtered in the streets where they live.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Kal is assigned by Nikya to spy on the Izzet near the Rubblebelt and watches them from a ruined spire.
timeline.quote: Kal was assigned a job by Nikya of the Old Ways to spy on the Izzet

citation.text: "Kal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nikya declares war on the Rakdos after the massacre of Cecilee's vernadi, over the perceived killing of Zi.
timeline.quote: Nikya declared war on the Rakdos, swearing revenge over the perceived killing of the Gruul infant Zi.

citation.text: "Kal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kal wakes to learn Massacre Girl escaped and the bloodwitch was killed by his spell; he is rewarded with Durri's smile.
timeline.quote: Nikya told him that Massacre Girl had escaped

citation.text: "Kal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cecilee establishes a healing outpost in the Rubblebelt and adopts the abandoned Gruul infant Zi.
timeline.quote: taking in an abandoned Gruul infant, naming him Zi

citation.text: "Rubblebelt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cecilee refuses to return the child to Nikya's warriors, straining the alliance.
timeline.quote: Cecilee refused, straining the fragile alliance

citation.text: "Rubblebelt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ruzi breaks from the Conclave, turns to the Gruul, and Nikya declares a blood feud against the Rakdos.
timeline.quote: Ruzi officially broke from the Conclave and turned to the Gruul
